notes.title: FUTURE OF SCP CARDTAINMENT BREACH! Newsletter: 8/26!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! this is 035! (by the way to help anyone confused its cause my youtube persona is 035)

i wanted to update players on my current progress and future of this game post full release update!
just want to say that i got some good news and some not so great news for fans..

 ==============================================================================

Updates I've finished:
- TONS OF BUG FIXES LOL
- Removed old background music
- Added an adaptive music system
- Alot of ai changes in singleplayer mode
- Changed descriptions of cards
- Rework of the effect system (originally item cards used to change the colors of cards to show that they -Were affected but due to bugs and if you stacked multiple effects on a card it would only show the most recent color)
- Cards no longer turn a different color when selecting a horde card / item cards
- Ui changes 

 ==============================================================================

THINGS TO ADD BEFORE I DROP THE UPDATE:

I'm currently having a lot of issue with netcode so most of the development process is me learning how to do it from scratch

i want to include a standard mode and a "draft" mode

draft would have the 2 players pick a card from 2 options, they keep the one they click and the opponent gets the other, idk i think it might introduce people to new card combo ideas that might be fun!

 ==============================================================================[/p][p]now for the bad news:

i really love this game, its my first ever, i'm a single developer and this game has given me a lot of learning opportunities. this game will always have a soft spot in my heart but i also want to learn tons of more stuff! I'm not saying "oh i'm gonna abandon this game!" but i do want to try new games here and there, i hope people wont be upset about this change. BUT there is a light to it, i WILL come back to this game for a 2.0 update! once Ive learnt and mastered my skill i would love to do a whole remaster of this game! (also don't worry the game will always be free lol)

 i've created a sub-forum in discussions for suggestions for the 2.0 update! 
ASWELL ive included a bug reporting sub-forum

if you wish to contact me, my email is: 
[/p][p][url="https://brewbytecontact@gmail.com"]brewbytecontact@gmail.com[/url]

 ==============================================================================[/p][p]
with deep love,

035[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: FUTURE OF SCP CARDTAINMENT BREACH!
notes.notes:
[p]Sorry for reposting but i do have some news! i'm kinda dumb lol i thought there was 2 months till Halloween! ill try and get this update out by the end of the month!

thanks for all the love and support ive been getting!
heres what you should expect from the 1.0.0 update![/p][p]
============================================================================== 
Features: 
Multiplayer system
better difficulty system 
dialogue and end screens remaster 
card effects remaster 
card type system
tutorial 
faster rounds 
3 different decks saves
new menu screen tab that lets you see more in-depth explanations 
Controller support settings menu while in game =============================================================================== Audio Remaster: 
add 066 clear board sfx 
add 001 (when day breaks) kill card sfx 
add 3008-1 activated sfx ("the store is now closed. please exit the building") add item consumption sfx add special sounds for cards that deal damage (red ice and glasses) add sfx to when its the player's turn =============================================================================== Visual Remaster: 
screen shake for when the player's hp is attacked (toggle in settings) 
screen shake and scream when 066 attacks (same toggle) 
peripheral jumper is half opacity if its yours (only for you)
 new in-game pfps! (096, 106, 049) 
scanline intensity in settings 
card tweening
company brand card intro =============================================================================== future card additions: 
scp 999 heals cards for 1 hp to the right and left of it for each round 
scp 939 rework? i might make it so it releases a gas that blocks its viewing and the opponent's card too? scp 096 was removed from current build cause his sprite is animated and im figuring him out lol scp 001 proposals! 
sheaf of papers: gives you a random card each round 
world gone beautiful: wipes the board after 3 rounds? =============================================================================== bug fixes: 
cards are visible on bottom of the screen when the game is completed
horde cards visual stats break when healing items are used 
hovering over a card whistle handed a new card enlarges it 
visual changes  
079 using 012 and 500 on itself and the player respectfully ===============================================================================  its going to take a while to get this update out, sorry for the future wait! if you have any bugs to report: email me at [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://brewbytecontact@gmail.com"]brewbytecontact@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]ill try and add it to my list of things to fix for the big update!

-035

[/p]
